description: This Java class acts as an adapter implementing the TextMap interface to facilitate injecting tracing context properties into a Vert.x MultiMap object for OpenTracing purposes.

classes.name: MultiMapInjectAdapter
classes.description: An adapter class implementing TextMap to inject tracing properties into a Vert.x MultiMap.

methods.name: MultiMapInjectAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with a given MultiMap object, ensuring it is non-null.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Throws UnsupportedOperationException as iteration over entries is not supported in this context.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Injects a key-value pair into the underlying MultiMap, with null checks on parameters.
